attributes.name: Distance Musket +1
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d10+1; you may additionally bury this card to add another 1d10. If you did not bury this card, roll 1d6, or 1d12 if proficient with weapons; on a 1, shuffle this card into your deck.

If proficient with weapons, discard this card to add 2d4 to any combat check by a character at another location.
